classification.observedFailure: The first Assessment Item candidate failed calculation-demand validation on q1. The single whole-artifact repair corrected that defect but then failed interpretation-demand validation on q5, blocking the full course.
classification.whyGeneric: The production diagnostic path catches the first semantic validation exception and presents it as the complete actionable defect set, while the assessment orchestrator converts a rejected Assessment Item candidate into a course-level blocker. Both behaviours apply across courses and providers rather than to AQA Business-specific educational content.

stopLoss.requiredBeforeNextFullCourse: deliberate architecture change and requalification of the affected production topology

architectureDecision.goal: credible trusted learner content through a repeatable automated course-production process
architectureDecision.principle: A bad AI-generated candidate is normal production scrap; the Content Factory fails only when it cannot recover automatically within governed quality, retry and spend limits.
candidateLifecycle: resample rejected candidate within bounded policy
generate and validate dependent Marking Pack independently
continue until blueprint coverage is satisfied
courseLevelBlockersReservedFor: unresolved course identity or learner option
unrecoverable upstream authority or coverage defect
exhausted governed candidate/retry or spend ceiling
material educational ambiguity that automation cannot resolve safely
infrastructure state that cannot be recovered by bounded retry/resume
requiredProductionProperties: complete multi-defect diagnostics for every parseable candidate before repair or rejection
slot-level or subartifact-level recovery rather than whole-course failure
accepted sibling artifacts remain immutable when another candidate fails
fresh candidate resampling is preferred to repeated whole-artifact repair where generative semantics are unstable
compiler ownership of mechanically provable assessment structure
qualified human subject review remains the benchmark gate

trustAndScaleAcceptance.repeatabilityTarget: new courses can traverse the same generic production contracts without course-specific engineering intervention
